m: 1. धैर्य n. (1. धीर) intelligence, forethought (opp. to माल्व्य), VS.; Kāṭh.
2. धैर्य n. (2. धीर) firmness, constancy, calmness, patience, gravity, fortitude, courage, (˚र्यं-√ कृ or अव-लम्ब् or आ-लम्ब्, to compose one's self, gather courage), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: धैर्यं — [धीरस्य भावः कर्म वा ष्यञ] 1 Firmness, durability, strength, constancy, steadiness, stability, fortitude, courage; धैर्यमवष्टभ्य Pt. 1; विपदि धैर्यं Bh. 2. 63; so धैर्यवृत्ति Śi. 9. 59. --2 Calmness, composure. --3 Gravity, patience. --4 Inflexibility. --5 Boldness, forwardness; Me. 40 (धाष्ट्ये Malli.).

m: धैर्य—धर mfn. possessed of firmness or constancy, Kāv.
धैर्य—ध्वंस m. failure of courage, MW.
धैर्य—कलित mfn. assuming firmness or composure, steady, calm, Śiś. ix, 59.
धैर्य—मित्र m. N. of a poet, Cat.
धैर्य—पारमिता f. highest perfection of perseverance, Kāraṇḍ.
धैर्य—ता f. constancy, perseverance, Pañcar. (for धीरता?)
धैर्य—वत् (R.; Rājat.) mfn. possessed of firmness or patience, firm, steady.
धैर्य—वृत्ति f. steady conduct, composure (Vikr. v, 9 read उज्झित-धैर्य-वृत्तिर् v.l. वृत्तम्)
धैर्य—वृत्ति mfn. of steady conduct, steadily behaved, MW.
धैर्य—युक्त (Hariv.) mfn. possessed of firmness or patience, firm, steady.

s: klI, (DIrasya BAvaH karmma vA । DIra + vyaY .) s: puM, (DImatAmayam । DImat + aR । pfzo darAditvAt masya vatvam .) saptasvarAntargatazazWasvaraH । sa tu nAradamate aSvasvaratulyaH । (aSvastu DEvataM rOtIti vacanAt ॥) tAnasenamate BekasvaratulyaH । asyAccAraRasTAnaM lalAwam । vyAkaraRamate dantaH । ayaM kzattriyavarRaH । asya jAtiH zAqavaH । asya tAnam 720 pratyekatAnam 48 samudAyena 34,560 Bavanti । iti saMgItaSAstram ॥ “gatvA nABeraDoBAgaM vastiM prApyordDvagaH punaH । DAvanniva ca yo yAti kaRwadeSaM sa DEvataH ॥” asya SrutayastisraH । iti saMgItadAmodaraH ॥ (yaTA ca saNgItadarpaRe । 1 । 55 । “madantI rohiRI ramyetyetA DEvatasaMSrayAH ॥” asya fzikule udBavaH । kzattriyo jAtiH । pIto varRaH । SvetadvIpe janma । fzistumburuH । gaReSo devatA । uzRik CandaH । vIBatsaBayAnakarasayorUpayogitvam । iti saNgItadarpaRam ॥)
v: pu॰ DImatAmayam aR pfzo॰ । tantrIkaRWotTita saptasvarezu zazWe svare tallakzaRaM yaTA “gatvA nABeraDoBAgaM vastiM prApyordDagaH punaH । DAvanniva ca yo yAti kaRWaM deSaM sa DEvataH” saNgItadAmo “aSvastu DEvataM rOti” saNgItaSAstrIkterasyASvasvaratulyatvam । asya ca vAyuBavatve'pi AkASaguRatvam BA॰ SA॰ 184 a॰ uktaM yaTA “tatrEkaguRamAkASaM Sabda ityeva tat smftam । tasya Sabdasya vakzyAmi vistaraM viviDAtmakam । zaqjafzaBagAnDArO maDyamo DEvatastaTA । paYcamaScApi vijYeyastaTA cApi nizAdavAn । eza saptaviDaH prokto guRa AkASasamBavaH । ESvaryyeRa tu sarvatra sTito'pi pawahAdizu । mfdaNgaBerISaNKAnAM stanayitnoraTasya ca । yaH kaScicCrUyate SabdaH prARino'prARino'pi vA । etezAmeva sarvezAM vizaye saMprakIrttitaH । evaM bahuviDAkAraH Sabda AkASasamBavaH । AkASajaM SabdamAhureBirvAyuguREH saha । avyAhatEScetayate na vetti vizamasTitEH” ।
m: धैवत n. the sixth note of the gamut, MBh. xii, 6859.
